text.glossary:background ability score flexib:
The DM is lenient with Ability Score Improvements from your background. While it's recommended you use only the ability scores your background improves, a secondary improvement to another statistic is allowed - provided the main ability score you're increasing is still one associated with your background.

Example: the Sage background lets you improve Constitution / Intelligence / Wisdom (either +2/+1 or +1/+1/+1). You could take +2 Intelligence and +1 Dexterity, even though Dexterity isn't on Sage's list - but you couldn't take +2 Dexterity and +1 Intelligence, since the +2 must come from your background. On a +1/+1/+1 split, 2 of the 3 must be from your background's list; the third can be any Ability Score.
